title: Height-Balanced Invariant Preservation in a PHP Generative Transformer for Handwriting and Sketches
topic: PenGPT: A Generative Transformer for Handwriting and Sketches
author: Mateus Yonathan
journal: Polyglot Systems Lab Agentic Research Preprints

abstract: We present AetherScript, a PHP-based generative transformer that synthesizes handwriting and sketch strokes by traversing a height-balanced search tree embedded in the transformer's attention graph. The tree maintains a strict height-balance invariant and key-ordering invariant during dynamic updates, enabling $O(\log n)$ amortized insertion, deletion, and lookup. We prove that the invariant guarantees a height bound of $h \le 1.44\log_2(n+2)$ and empirically evaluate the implementation on an AMD EPYC 7763 64-Core Processor with 1 physical core and 2 logical threads. Across 30 benchmark iterations, the mean latency is 43 465.29 \textmu{}s (Std Dev $\pm$ 650.56 \textmu{}s), P50 = 43 509.56 \textmu{}s, P95 = 44 595.51 \textmu{}s, P99 = 44 866.11 \textmu{}s, and throughput is 23 007 ops/s. \textbf{Source Code}: \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/php-backend-core/tree/main/algorithms/20261125_050120_pengpt__a_generative_transform}
